baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَضَلَّانَا ... نَجْعَلْهُمَا تَحْتَ أَقْدَامِنَا ... مِنَ ٱلْأَسْفَلِينَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The speakers convert attributed causal precedence into punitive spatial and social inferiority: the pair credited with directing them away is to be remade as a trampled lower rank.

activation_trace.role: Deviation from guidance supplies the directional harm attributed to the pair.
Making something assume a condition supplies the deliberate conversion of the pair's rank.
The physically lower direction supplies the geometry of subordination.
The foot that treads supplies the bodily interface of punitive domination.
Lowness of social standing converts the bodily image into degradation of status.

changed_reading.before: They ask that two misleaders be punished.
changed_reading.after: They script punishment as a vertical reversal in which blamed guides are converted into a trampled lower class so the speakers recover relative precedence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ... أَرِنَا ... مِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ
baseline_models.mechanism: Truth-coverers ask for an act of showing that exposes agency across the hidden jinn and manifest human poles; the request reverses concealment before it proceeds to punishment.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the speakers' own relation to what has been obscured.
Causing something to be seen supplies the requested reversal from concealment to exposure.
Hiddenness from sense supplies the concealed pole of the blamed agency.
Manifest humanity opposed to the jinn supplies the perceptible pole of the pair.

changed_reading.before: The speakers merely request identification of two culprits from jinn and humankind.
changed_reading.after: Their request is a counter-concealment operation: people defined by covering ask that hidden and manifest channels of agency be made perceptible.

baseline_models.mechanism: The switch from an imperative addressed to the sovereign Lord to first-person plural making divides the act: divine authority is asked to disclose the targets, while the petitioners reserve their demotion for themselves.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech supplies the public petition that assigns roles.
Lordship and sovereignty supply the authority from whom disclosure is requested.
Showing supplies the divine epistemic act requested by the speakers.
Assigning a condition supplies the retaliatory act the speakers claim for themselves.

changed_reading.before: They ask God to punish their misleaders.
changed_reading.after: They ask God for evidentiary access, then imagine themselves executing the status reversal; the prayer preserves rather than surrenders their will to dominate.

context_deltas.mechanism: The demand for showing follows both a declared sensory enclosure and an organized attempt to manufacture it: covered hearts, weighted ears, a barrier, prohibited listening, and noise aimed at prevailing. Their lack of sight is therefore partly an achieved policy, not merely something done to them.

activation_trace.role: Requested showing supplies the belated demand for perceptual access.
A protective cover supplies the speakers' announced enclosure of their hearts.
Weight in the ear supplies their claimed auditory blockage.
A screening barrier supplies the declared separation from the message.
Hearing as understanding and response supplies the reception they order others to withhold.
Mixed clamor supplies the active production of auditory occlusion.
Conquering force supplies the strategic aim of the manufactured blockage.

structural_cues: 41:5's enclosure claims and 41:26's no-listening command precede 41:29's imperative أَرِنَا.
The sensory sequence moves from refusing reception to demanding visual disclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covers, ear-weight, barrier, prohibited listening, clamor, and the later request to be shown; I infer that the epistemic deficit is partly self-produced. A live alternative is that these are collective portraits rather than the conduct of every individual speaker.

changed_reading.before: They need revelation because the agents who misled them are hidden.
changed_reading.after: Their demand for sight also indicts a prior policy of blocking reception: they ask for disclosure only after declaring and weaponizing occlusion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Just before the focus, sensory faculties and skins become speaking witnesses to what their owners did. The foot in the focus can no longer function as an innocent instrument for exporting blame: embodied agency has already become evidence against the agent.

activation_trace.role: The treading foot supplies the bodily instrument the speakers recruit for retaliation.
Presence with witnessed perception turns the body scene into an evidentiary mechanism.
The body's skin supplies an intimate witness that cannot be displaced onto an external culprit.
Intentional deed supplies what the embodied witnesses disclose.
Speech made possible for the skins supplies the body's conversion from instrument to witness.

structural_cues: 41:20-22 foreground hearing, sight, and skin immediately before 41:29 foregrounds feet.
The testimony is explicitly tied to what the speakers themselves had been doing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily testimony to deeds and a later treading foot; I extend the evidentiary force from the named faculties and skin to embodied action generally. The live alternative is that the passage never says the feet themselves testify.

changed_reading.before: Their feet are neutral instruments for punishing the guilty pair.
changed_reading.after: The underfoot fantasy uses a body already implicated as counterwitness, so the gesture cannot cleanly transfer culpability away from the speakers' own action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly assigns an inward share of causality: blindness is preferred, outcomes are earned, a supposition about the Lord causes ruin, and evil returns upon the self. The two misleaders remain possible causes, but the focus cry concentrates a distributed causal field onto two punishable bodies.

activation_trace.role: Departure from guidance supplies the harm the speakers attribute externally.
Love lodged in the heart supplies active preference rather than passive victimhood.
Blindness of insight supplies the state that is chosen over guidance.
Acquisition by one's effort supplies responsibility for the resulting state.
Unsecured supposition supplies an internal cognitive cause.
Falling into destruction supplies the explicit effect of that supposition.
The self as the very person supplies the destination of moral consequence.
The act that causes harm supplies what returns against its doer.

structural_cues: The focus uses a causative verb with two external subjects, while 41:23 gives the speakers' own supposition an explicit destructive predicate.
41:17 and 41:46 frame blindness and harm through preference, earning, and return to self.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies several explicit inward causal links; I infer that 41:29 selectively compresses them into an accusation against two agents. The live alternative is additive causality: external seduction and accountable assent can both be fully operative.

changed_reading.before: Two external agents caused the fall and therefore deserve concentrated retaliation.
changed_reading.after: The accusation is a blame-concentration move inside distributed causality: companions may mislead, but preference, earning, supposition, and self-returning action prevent the speakers from becoming mere victims.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding companions are attached alongside the people and beautify the field before and behind them. The focus then remaps that intimate lateral and temporal enclosure into a vertical one: those who occupied the horizon are to be moved underfoot.

activation_trace.role: A companion joined to a companion supplies proximate attachment rather than remote command.
Making something appear beautiful supplies the perceptual mechanism of misdirection.
What lies before the hands supplies the forward part of the framed horizon.
What lies behind supplies the rear or past-facing part of the same enclosure.
The hidden jinn class supplies one repeated domain from which the focus names its blamed pair.
Manifest humankind supplies the other repeated domain of the focus accusation.
The lower direction supplies the destination imposed on formerly adjacent companions.
Precedence and rank within the foot branch sharpen the reversal from influential proximity to inferior status.

structural_cues: 41:25 immediately precedes the punishment sequence and repeats ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ before 41:29.
The spatial-temporal pair before/behind is answered by the focus's under/feet.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attached companions, beautification, front and rear, then underfoot; I infer a topological reversal from surrounding proximity to vertical subordination. Front and rear may primarily denote future and past, but that alternative still supports control of the speakers' temporal horizon.

changed_reading.before: The misleaders are superior commanders who directed followers from above.
changed_reading.after: They appear as attached companions whose beautification occupied the speakers' front-and-back horizon; the punishment fantasy converts intimacy and framing into inferiority.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same class formula introduces unbelievers who command others not to listen, to drown the recitation in noise, and thereby prevail. In the focus they speak as the misled; packet sequence makes the accusation recursive because the accusers have occupied the social role of misleaders.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech supplies the accusation voiced by the unbelieving collective.
Deviation from guidance supplies the role they assign exclusively to the blamed pair.
The repeated speech act supplies the collective's own directive intervention.
Obstruction of truth supplies the shared subject class across directive and accusation.
Hearing as comprehension supplies the reception they try to prevent in others.
Deflection from the right course supplies their active method of misleading.
Prevailing by force supplies the intended social effect of that deflection.

structural_cues: 41:26 and 41:29 both begin with the same وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ formula.
The first speech directs others away from reception; the second identifies others as those who directed the speakers away.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated class formula and the two speech acts; I infer role recursion at the collective level. This does not prove that each individual in the eschatological crowd personally issued the earlier command.

changed_reading.before: The speakers are victims seeking the agents who misled them.
changed_reading.after: They are accusers from a collective already shown manufacturing misguidance, so their complaint is also a perpetrator's attempt to isolate blame in someone else.

context_deltas.mechanism: Adjacent speeches share the saying of 'our Lord' but diverge in motion. In the focus, the address launches a plan to put others below; in 41:30, saying 'our Lord is God' continues into rectitude and a consoling descent of angels. The truth of the address is disclosed by its trajectory.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech supplies the first 'our Lord' formula.
Lordship supplies the shared address whose consequences diverge.
Social baseness supplies the downward outcome sought by the first speech.
Degraded standing completes the first speech's trajectory.
The repeated utterance supplies the contrasting 'our Lord is God' formula.
The same lordship branch makes the contrast depend on what follows the address, not on the noun alone.
Straightness and balance supply the embodied sequel to the faithful confession.
Beneficent descent supplies a downward movement opposite in function to forced degradation.

structural_cues: 41:29 and 41:30 are adjacent and repeat قالوا ربنا.
The first continuation is underfoot and lowest; the second is rectitude followed by angelic descent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the adjacent formula and opposed motions; I read the juxtaposition as testing confession by its sequel. A live alternative is that 41:30 simply contrasts a different group without directly glossing the prior address.

changed_reading.before: Calling on 'our Lord' marks a repentant or faithful turn by the punished speakers.
changed_reading.after: The address alone proves little: here it serves retaliatory hierarchy, whereas the next 'our Lord' becomes credible through rectitude and a descent that consoles rather than degrades.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later vertical instruction directs people to lower themselves before the Creator, while arrogance is the refusal. The focus instead seeks elevation through the forced lowering of others, exposing two opposed uses of verticality: worshipful self-abasement and retaliatory status domination.

activation_trace.role: The lower direction supplies the position imposed on someone else.
The treading foot supplies the speakers' retained bodily elevation.
Degraded standing supplies the outcome assigned to the other.
Voluntary lowering supplies the commanded bodily relation when directed to God rather than created powers.
Submissive worship supplies the purpose of self-lowering.
Pride and self-magnification supply the resistance to that posture.

structural_cues: The focus's feet remain above while others are forced below; 41:37 commands the addressee's own prostration.
41:38 immediately names arrogant refusal before contrasting worship near the Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forced other-lowering, commanded self-lowering, and arrogance; I infer a vertical ethic contrasting domination with worship. The later command addresses a living audience, so it is a thematic countermodel rather than a claim that the damned could perform it then.

changed_reading.before: Putting the misleaders underfoot is simply proportionate humiliation.
changed_reading.after: The wish preserves an arrogant vertical logic: the speakers seek height by lowering others, whereas the surah's proper bodily descent is one's own submission to the Creator.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus proposes transforming a hostile relation by changing the enemy's rank; 41:34 proposes transforming it by a better response until hostility becomes intimate alliance. These are competing causal mechanisms for what to do with an adversarial other.

activation_trace.role: Making another assume a status supplies coercive relational transformation.
Degraded social rank supplies the only endpoint imagined for the hostile pair.
Doing the good supplies the alternative input that changes the relation.
Pushing away harm supplies a response that resists without placing the other beneath oneself.
Enmity supplies the initial relation shared by the countermodel.
Affection and support supply the transformed relation.
Intimate closeness supplies the endpoint opposite to degraded distance.

structural_cues: Both passages contain a relational conversion: make the blamed pair lowest versus make an enemy like an intimate ally.
The two mechanisms preserve multiplicity rather than yielding a single rule for eschatological and present conflict.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two explicit transformations of an adversarial relation; I set them in contrast. A materially live alternative is that 41:29 describes irreversible eschatological accusation while 41:34 governs present ethical response, limiting direct transfer.

changed_reading.before: Their proposed humiliation straightforwardly models just relational reversal.
changed_reading.after: It also reads as speech still unable to imagine relation except through rank domination, sharply unlike the later mechanism that converts enmity through a better response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus asks for external persons to be shown as the explanation of error. The surah's close reuses seeing and astrayness but redirects disclosure: the deeply astray subject is in distant rupture, and God shows signs in horizons and selves until truth becomes clear. Seeing culprits is displaced by seeing evidence and oneself.

activation_trace.role: Causing another to see supplies the focus request for external disclosure.
Departure from guidance supplies the condition they explain through two others.
Interrogative attention supplies a demand that the addressees examine their own premise.
Straying now characterizes the opposed subject rather than only an effect imposed by a named pair.
A group split by opposition supplies the subject's own relational location in error.
Distance from nearness supplies the depth of that self-location.
Divine showing supplies the answer to the focus's demand but changes what is shown.
The person's own self supplies an inward field of evidence.
Emergence into clarity supplies the result of that redirected showing.
Stable truth matching reality supplies the object ultimately disclosed.

structural_cues: أَرِنَا in 41:29 and سَنُرِيهِمْ in 41:53 share the causative seeing construction.
أَضَلَّانَا in 41:29 and أَضَلُّ in 41:52 share the straying root while changing causal syntax.
The requested object shifts from two others to signs in horizons and selves.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the root echoes and changed objects of showing; I infer an epistemic correction from scapegoat-visibility to truth- and self-visibility. The external signs do not cancel the reality of external tempters, so this is redirection rather than disproof.

changed_reading.before: Truth will arrive once the speakers can see the two people responsible for their error.
changed_reading.after: The surah answers that demand by changing the field of vision: decisive showing concerns signs, the self, and truth, while deepest straying is located in the subject's own distant rupture.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The valency reversal is surprising: the focus has agents causing people to stray, whereas 41:48 has invoked objects themselves go missing from their callers. It remains anchored by the exact ض ل ل root and the focus's demand to locate blamed agents, but downstream prose must treat it as a root-level echo and must not identify what was invoked in 41:48 with the exact pair in 41:29.

activation_trace.role: Showing supplies the attempt to locate and expose the blamed pair.
Deviation from guidance supplies the causative accusation.
Loss of a thing from its owner reverses the root so the relied-on objects become unlocatable.
Calling by speech supplies the failed relation to what disappears.
Turning aside from a direction supplies the absence of an escape route after the disappearance.

changed_reading.before: The speakers can restore order by locating the agents who made them lose the way.
changed_reading.after: The root echo permits a more unstable picture: callers, called objects, and guides inhabit reciprocal lostness, so locating two culprits cannot by itself recover an exit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the packet's non-dominant mapping of focus ر ب ب to ر ب و through 41:39's rising earth; it is not a claim that رَبَّنَا lexically means the earth rose. It remains valid as a packet-authorized cross-root image anchored in رَبَّنَا and the focus's downward lexicon, and downstream prose should label it explicitly as an exploratory vertical resonance.

activation_trace.role: Increase and elevation supply a latent upward branch inside the packet's split mapping for the divine address.
Being made to descend supplies the punitive downward vector opposed to that branch.
The earth's life-bearing motion supplies the transition from low stillness to animation.
Increase and rising in the earth make the non-dominant focus branch contextually active.

changed_reading.before: The invocation of the Lord simply authorizes a request to force others downward.
changed_reading.after: An exploratory branch hears an inversion: the address carries a latent image of generative rising, activated by earth swelling to life, while the speakers can imagine vertical power only as making others descend.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The cross-scene pattern is surprising because it links cosmological association in 41:9 with eschatological retaliation in 41:29 through repeated ج ع ل. It remains anchored in the exact making verb and rank language, but the second-person audience and later collective need not be identical individuals; render it as a discourse-level compulsion to manipulate rank, not as a biographical claim.

activation_trace.role: Assigning a condition or rank supplies the intended demotion of the blamed pair.
Low social standing supplies the endpoint of the later rank assignment.
The same status-making branch supplies the earlier assignment of peers to the Lord.
A rival counterpart supplies the falsely elevated rank created in the earlier scene.
Sovereign lordship supplies the rank against which peers are improperly made.

changed_reading.before: The underfoot request is an isolated wish for retribution.
changed_reading.after: It can also be heard as the late form of a rank-making compulsion: first assigning rivals beside the Lord, then assigning blamed guides beneath the self.

strongest_changes: The request to be shown follows self-declared covers and a deliberate no-listening noise strategy, making ignorance partly manufactured.
41:17, 41:23, and 41:46 redistribute causality back through preference, earning, supposition, and consequence to self.
41:25 changes remote leaders into attached companions who beautify the front-and-back horizon before being topologically reassigned underfoot.
Bodily testimony makes the retaliatory foot part of implicated embodied agency rather than a neutral instrument.
The closing reuse of causative seeing redirects disclosure from two external culprits toward signs, the self, and truth.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet activated a coherent set of causal and spatial reversals: concealment to showing, companionate surround to underfoot rank, self-lowering to other-lowering, and external accusation to inward disclosure. It also preserved two useful oddities: reciprocal lostness under ض ل ل and the packet-authorized ر ب ب/ر ب و rising branch.
remaining_uncertainties: The dual may denote a representative jinn-human pair, but 41:25's plural communities do not identify the exact two.
The repeated unbelieving collective in 41:26 and 41:29 supports role recursion without proving identical individual speakers.
Underfoot may function chiefly as an idiom of humiliation, which limits the body-witness extension from skin and faculties to feet.
The ر ب ب to ر ب و elevation model is intentionally exploratory and must not be rendered as direct lexical equivalence.
